text: Candid Rütter is a multimedia composer and sound artist. During his studies (BA Sound Arts, HKB Bern; MA Multimedia Composition, HFMT Hamburg), his artistic practice moved steadily away from musical composition toward spatial and scenic work. Mentors including Cathy Van Eck, Robin Meier and Alexander Schubert accompanied his artistic development along the way. A central concern of his work is how the absence or presence of things shapes perception and imagination. Human perception as a compositional factor and an experimental approach to form are key to this. In terms of content, his work deals with human disorientation in a technological reality that keeps expanding. Candid's pieces have been performed at venues including Gessnerallee Zürich ([escapism \[2022\]](https://candidruetter.net/works/escapism/), Backslash Festival), Lichthoftheater ([HOLY WATER \[2024\]](https://candidruetter.net/works/holywater/), We Present Festival), Resonanzraum ([folds of silk \[2025\]](https://candidruetter.net/works/foldsofsilk/), Silkroad Festival) and the Forum of the HFMT ([the meadow \[2026\]](https://candidruetter.net/works/the-meadow/), master's graduation concert). Alongside his own work, Candid takes part in a range of collaborations. His compositions for dance and theatre have reached audiences on stages such as Kampnagel Hamburg, Konzert und Theater St. Gallen and TD Berlin. Candid also works as a producer for the band [Prix Garanti](https://candidruetter.net/collectives/prixgaranti/) and curates music for the label [Critter](https://candidruetter.net/collectives/crttr/), with a focus on experimental club music. 20356 Hamburg me@candidruetter.net CV (PDF)
